title: Coddling, Kowtowing, and Delighting II
description: Coddling, Kowtowing, and Delighting II — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Junior Exec Ivan

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill 15 Ice Orok AC Repairmen and 3 Ice Orok AC Overseers in Upper Frump's Misfortune then Return to Junior Exec Ivan in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Junior Exec Ivan

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Frump's Misfortune (quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Kill 15 Ice Orok AC Repairmen and 3 Ice Orok AC Overseers in Upper Frump's Misfortune then Return to Junior Exec Ivan in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

Offer:

Are you familiar with the ancient phrase, 'Kicketh the tires and lighteth the fires'? Well, it is a good thing, and is exactly what you are doing, so I think I'm just going to sit back and watch you doeth what it is that you doeth.

Nothing new this time, just get out there into Upper Frump's Misfortune and take out the Ice Orok AC Repairmen and Ice Orok AC Overseers. When you get done return to me, Junior Exec Ivan, in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

Turn-in:

You really are a pleasure to watch when you are running the dungeon. A true classless act! Let me know if you want to take another run.

Objectives:

  • Slain Ice Orok AC Repairmen
  • Slain Ice Orok AC Overseers

Level range: 35–50
